copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过 Chat SDK 在 Microsoft Teams 频道、群聊和私聊中收发消息。它会自动复制 Teams 适配器代码、注册适配器、安装依赖包，并引导你完成 Teams 机器人创建和安装流程。
howto.when: 当你需要将 Claude 接入 Microsoft Teams 时触发。技能会检查环境变量中是否已有 Teams 凭据，若无则启动完整的设置流程。

say.text: 帮我把 Claude 接入 Microsoft Teams。
say.note: 启动 Teams 集成设置流程。

say.text: 我需要一个 Teams 机器人来接收消息。
say.note: 触发机器人创建和安装步骤。

say.text: 检查 Teams 集成是否已配置。
say.note: 技能会检测现有凭据并报告状态。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send and receive messages in Microsoft Teams channels, group chats, and direct messages via the Chat SDK. It copies the Teams adapter, registers it, installs dependencies, and guides you through bot creation and installation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to integrate Claude with Microsoft Teams. The skill checks for existing Teams credentials in .env; if missing, it starts the full setup process.

say_en.text: Help me connect Claude to Microsoft Teams.
I need a Teams bot to receive messages.
say_en.note: Triggers bot creation and installation steps.

say_en.text: Check if Teams integration is configured.
say_en.note: Skill detects existing credentials and reports status.
